label: Pre-encounter — news through the stone
location: The deep settlements, the foundation spans

recentEvents.value: The stone carries news from the upper realms: collapses where no cave-in should be, tunnel mouths dropped behind fleeing families.
It has begun pre-shoring the deep tunnels and drilling the settlements on the way up.

unresolvedConflicts.value: Somewhere above, a voice is causing the collapses it exists to undo — and it still reads him as a rescue.

temporaryObjective.value: Shore every span and rehearse every evacuation route before the noise comes down.

notes: Future content (rungs 11+); no quest stages exist yet, so activeQuestStages is empty. Per its profile it cannot stop treating the hero as a rescue case — the dread is real, but so is the flaw.
